description: Trial version, not for production, online for a limited time. Without a key, this first call creates the trial. Builds the code sent (or the GitHub or GitLab repository linked with link_git_repo, or an image) and deploys it to an environment, in place of the previous version; the response gives the version, its address, its build and what changed.

confirm_overwrite.description: true: while.yaml overwrites what a person changed on screen.

digest.description: sha256:<64 hex>; without it, while resolves it: the image always goes by its digest.

image.description: OCI image already built (while registry or external), ideally with its digest.

intent.description: Content of while.yaml, when deploying an image without sending sources.

language.description: Trial creation: your human's language. while's texts for them are in that language, to_say included. Without this parameter, your session's language, then English.

redeploy.description: A version already built, put back online with today's variables and secrets (after set_env, or to restart an app that went down), without rebuilding. Going back: rollback_app.

release.description: The number returned by an upload (or a version in progress): deploy_app follows its build and its deployment.

source_archive_base64.description: Last resort, slow: the tar.gz archive of the sources, in base64. Exclusive with image and release.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait; beyond it, the response says how to resume.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

wait.description: false: returns at once (follow with deploy_app { release }).

name: deploy_app
title: Deploy an app
